content: react-native-iap 16.6.0 (latest, 2026): NOT deprecated; development moved to OpenIAP monorepo, npm package unchanged; expo-iap is a sibling project on the same OpenIAP core, no migration required. Nitro-based since v14, requires RN >=0.79 and react-native-nitro-modules peer. Expo: the package itself is the config plugin ('react-native-iap' in plugins array); docs show expo-build-properties kotlinVersion override; Expo Go unsupported - dev build required.
